global_invariants: Rune atoms/connectors/SCI/CSL/progression bands remain governed proposal-stage design unless later completion acceptance explicitly locks them; they are not recovered source canon.
Spell names, glyphs, sigils, scripts and macros do not automatically become rune atoms or Rune Constructions.
Mixed connector types never receive implicit precedence; explicit grouping and canonical linear round-trip are required.
SCI measures structural/cognitive complexity only; CSL measures structural stability attention only; neither is power, affordability, failure probability, backlash or guaranteed balance.

Rune Construction never invents one universal resource formula. Required mana/charge/material/time/DC/capacity/fatigue/Overreach/Resonance/counterspell/resistance/progression inputs resolve through owning rules or remain explicitly unresolved.
Source-specific mana, XP, material, charge, crafting DC and Resonance values remain scoped; Scripts & Macros progression conflict remains attributable and unresolved unless governed separately.
PPIA-03 retains Item Definition/instance ownership; PPIA-08 retains Campaign/Scene current-state ownership; PPIA-12 retains setting-local scope; PPIA-11 retains final balance calibration.
Authorize and filter before hidden payloads, targets, anchors, channels, inscriptions, constructions, counts, previews, diagnostics, exports, notifications or AI context are resolved or aggregated.
AI/generated constructions are proposals only until explicit governed acceptance with provenance.
Authoritative Rune Construction and inscription mutations use expected-version plus operation-ID/idempotent recovery; ambiguous responses require status/current-version lookup before retry.

Every visual graph/topology/shape workflow has canonical ordered linear text, keyboard/touch/high-zoom/reflow and screen-reader-equivalent operation; drag, hover, color and animation are never required.
No workflow activates STAGE-A-A2, application runtime, release, deployment, tester access, paid services or production credentials.

handoff_contracts.contract: Owns generic browse/inspect/select/provenance UI. PPIA-07 supplies rune-specific semantic projections and cannot leak hidden facts through generic search/count/compare.
Owns Item Definition/instance and authoritative item mutation. PPIA-07 owns only rune-extension data, validation and predicted rune effect metadata attached through governed references.
Owns Campaign/Scene instantiation and current state. Rune Construction Definitions remain reusable/versioned and are not rewritten by runtime placement, activation, damage, discovery or removal.
Owns final balance calibration and benchmark methodology. SCI/CSL are explainability/risk signals only and cannot be promoted to power/failure formulas.
Owns setting-local scope. Setting-specific rune/magic rules remain local unless explicit promotion authority exists.

Own authoritative resolution, spell/effect registries, mana/resistance/counterspell/fatigue/Overreach and adopted execution rules. PPIA-07 packages construction semantics without redefining those mechanics.
Authorize/filter before hidden rune facts, targets, channels, anchors, counts, diagnostics, exports, notifications or AI context are resolved or serialized.
Authoritative Rune Construction or inscription writes use expected-version and operation-ID semantics; ambiguous responses require status/current-version lookup before retry.
Visual graphs, geometry, drag, color, hover and animation are supplemental. Every required authoring/inspection path has keyboard, screen-reader and linear-text equivalents.
